notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and Sakashima the Impostor.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 4.
